title: Invasive Species Risk Engine
description: A Python, FAISS, FastAPI and React app that runs HNSW similarity search over 96k+ species embeddings at under 50ms p95, fusing GBIF, Open-Meteo and Trefle feeds into a two-factor climate-and-biology risk model.

title: OneTap NFC Data Interchange
description: A Flask/MySQL backend for NFC tag provisioning, uploads and analytics across 8 sites and 500+ users, streaming uploads to S3 via presigned URLs and cutting operational cost 33% versus the prior QR-based system.

title: Facial Recognition Attendance Kiosks
description: A FaceNet and MTCNN identity-verification pipeline serving 250+ students per day behind a Django API, with a quantized on-device model holding under 300ms end-to-end match latency.

title: RAG Financial Assistant (Hyland Software)
description: A RAG and natural-language-to-SQL assistant for 20 analysts, using an IVF-PQ FAISS index over 50M+ records and multi-join SQL across 100+ tables to cut turnaround from 10 minutes to 5 seconds.

title: Real-Time Candidate Evaluation (Bridge)
description: A real-time screen-capture evaluation pipeline over WebSockets that scores candidate code at sub-second latency, using Tesseract OCR and computer-vision frame diffing to cut evaluation time 50%+.

title: Bill Summarization Pipeline (CMU)
description: A LangGraph pipeline chunking and summarizing thousands of bills, with a hybrid BM25 and dense retriever plus cross-encoder re-ranking, cutting manual analysis time 90%.

title: VEX Autonomous Stack (Millburn Robotics)
description: A C++17 autonomous stack (Pure Pursuit and PID) at 100 Hz with odometry and IMU sensor fusion, winning 90% of autonomous periods at the VEX World Championships.

title: Telehealth Scheduling API (VidVeda HealthCare)
description: A Flask/PostgreSQL REST API for consults and scheduling with WebRTC video and JWT auth, scaling to 1,000+ users and deployed on AWS ECS with 99.9%+ uptime.
